title: I built a FREE Word Puzzle Game for improve your Critical Thinking skills
author: JeanLuucGodard
selftext:
The game is like Wordle by NY Time, but instead of one game, you'll get 7 games per day and a dashboard to understand your thought performance.

Rules are simple:

* Guess the **WORD** in 6 tries.
* Each guess must be a valid 5-letter word.
* The colour of the tiles changes to show how close your guess was to the word.

  
Try it out and consider giving some reviews.

Link: [Word Pogo](https://word-pogo.vercel.app/)

replies.author: JeanLuucGodard
replies.body:
Stardew valley was inspired by Harvest Moon
Bioshock was inspired by System Shock 2
Undertale was inspired by Earth bound

And I can give you a 1000 examples.

Getting inspired from something is not a bad thing. If it was not for inspirations, most of these titles wont ever be made.

I found the game fun and there was a hard paywall to the game to play more.

As a dev, my first instinct was to Vibecode similar game with some of my own creative additions and play it for free.

Is it a bad thing? After all, I am not asking for money or anything. I'm just asking for some honest reviews.

If this game triggered you in any way, I apologise for it.
